title: TimePicker configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.TimePickerAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

AllowInput.description: Stores the ability to allow inputs to be editable or not

DisableMobile.description: Stores the ability to disable the mobile flatpickr behavior. False is the default provider option

FirstWeekDay.description: First day of the week (0 = Sunday); forwarded to the provider locale.

InitialTime.description: Time selected when the picker is built (HH:mm).

Is24Hours.description: Uses a 24-hour clock; false shows an AM/PM selector.

TimeFormat.description: Display format of the selected time.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
